items.description: Standing in place with nothing urgent to do, waiting a while before deciding what's next.
Moving on foot from one place to another.
Waiting inside a building, out of sight, until it's their turn to come out.
Eating a grub from a stockpile or a home stash to satisfy hunger.
Digging up a grub from a mound, whether to eat it or to carry it elsewhere.
Gathering a stick or rock (and maybe a bonus flint) from the ground near a tree or stone deposit, to carry elsewhere.
Drinking at a pond's edge to satisfy thirst.
